_comment: Single source of truth for services and prices. Read by the gateway (quotes, orders, MIP-003 pricing), the Node agent layer (Sokosumi paid tasks) and the registration script. Amounts are integer base units of the payment token (6 decimals).

land_audit.title: Land Audit
land_audit.summary: Wind / solar due-diligence verdict for one parcel or site, with sources, data quality and limits.
land_audit.deliverable: Audit report (verdict, score, grid/regulatory/environment checks, data-quality table) as canonical JSON plus a Markdown rendering. A correct NO_GO report is a completed service.

lease_check.title: Lease Check
lease_check.summary: Compares lease contracts, official parcel records and farmed fields; finds paid-but-unfarmed land, area mismatches, above-benchmark rents and expiring leases; produces a report and calendar reminders. With field outlines: Sentinel-2 crop status, a season biomass estimate and a check of 5am.earth field registrations on Cardano.
lease_check.deliverable: Lease report where every finding is recomputed from the source rows before delivery (status pass/fail), plus an .ics reminder file.

pool_access.title: Pool Access
pool_access.summary: Both-sides-consented introduction between two energy developers: NDA signing by both parties, disclosure of the counterpart's parcel and contacts, and a preliminary joint-project calculation with draft agreement and grid-application documents.
pool_access.deliverable: Revealed counterpart package + joint-project plan (shares in basis points, layout, NPV) + draft pooling agreement and grid-connection application PDFs, delivered only after both NDAs are signed. One payment covers disclosure and calculation.
